crossRefs.note: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

translations.web: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
translations.bsb: You must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it out upon the earth as water.
